0022600225.text: The Warriors arrive at Houston on a seven-game winning streak, 7-3 overall and 2nd in the Pacific, 2 games back, and 7th in the West, while the Rockets are 8-3, riding a one-game win streak, and sit 2nd in the Southwest, 0.5 games back, and 5th in the West. Golden State is without Gary Payton II (knee, inflammation), Jimmy Butler III (knee, surgery), Kristaps Porzingis (illness), Moses Moody (knee, surgery), and Will Richard (thumb), while Houston is missing Clint Capela (ankle, sprain) and Steven Adams (calf, strain) and has Oscar Tshiebwe listed as day-to-day with an illness and a game-time decision. The teams have not met yet in the 2026-27 season, and the Warriors lost 1-2 in the 2025-26 season series, including a 117-116 loss in San Francisco on April 5, 2026.
